timeout_reason: The existing PipelineMapping.start constructor omits batch_timeout_seconds, so the consumer uses its 300-second default.
mapping_counter_semantics: Mapping messages_processed counts successful processing callbacks, including final-drain retries that reuse acknowledged Elastic receipts. It is not a count of unique source events or persisted target rows.
acceptance_basis: Producer and receiver counts, SDK submission counts, exact persisted SQL results and both partition checkpoint positions agree. Raw evidence is preserved in live-test.json; final replay intentionally creates four duplicates.
